sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Programmatic Real-Time Ad Exchange and SSP Platform

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu - International Company regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila and Luganville
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid legal system: English common law foundation, French civil-law influence, and customary (kastom) law; corporate statutes follow the English and Commonwealth model, notably the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive double taxation agreement in force for Vanuatu as of the current treaty list
Vanuatu-New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2010)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus (2017)
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) membership
Vanuatu membership of the World Trade Organization (2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended by the Companies and International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Amendment Act 2021; Companies Act [Cap 191] as amended; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2018 and subsidiary Regulations as amended through 2021; Registered Agents and Trustees Licensing Act [Cap 227]; VFSC AML/CFT Guidelines for licensed registered agents; FATF Recommendations and Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering mutual evaluation requirements applicable to Vanuatu.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the VFSC-licensed registered agent and retained counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Notary Public / Commissioner for Oaths
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Vanuatu is not a contracting state to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; legalization by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and External Trade and, where required, by the consular post of the foreign jurisdiction where the document will be used

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statutory UBO declaration, consent to act, and source-of-funds declaration for each subscriber and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Signatory before a Vanuatu Notary Public or VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization where presentation to a foreign bank, regulator, or tax authority is anticipated

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the incorporator/subscriber
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporator and VFSC-licensed registered agent; certified by VFSC upon incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: VFSC certified copy; Consular Legalization for foreign official use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and, when issued, Certificate of Good Standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Registrar of Companies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified VFSC copy; Consular Legalization for presentation to correspondent banks and foreign authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency identifying directors, shareholder(s), registered agent, and registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized and Consular Legalization path for counterparty banks and regulated institutions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/KYC document pack: certified passport copies, proof of residential address, source of wealth, and sanctions/PEP screening report
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport office or public authority of origin, utility provider, retained counsel or due diligence provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized true copies; Consular Legalization when demanded by a foreign bank or statutory body

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of every director, shareholder, ultimate beneficial owner, and authorised signatory against the OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN Lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, Australian DFAT Consolidated List, and Vanuatu FIU/regulator designation notices; PEP identification per FATF Recommendation 12 covering foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, international organization PEPs, family members, and close associates; negative media and legal adverse data review via licensed commercial databases, name matching on full name, date of birth, nationality, and address; any hit triggers enhanced due diligence, risk committee review, and verified source-of-funds documentation; refresh at least annually and on any material change in ownership or control.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registry and Name Reservation Desk, Port Vila; electronic filing through the VFSC e-Registry portal at www.vfsc.vu or via a licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory working languages are Bislama, English, and French; a corporate name may use Latin-script English, French, or Bislama words; non-Latin character names must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet; under section 17 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222], an International Company name must end with the token 'Limited' or 'Ltd'; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to a name already registered or reserved on the VFSC register within the reservation window.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Building Society, Savings, Finance - require prior Reserve Bank of Vanuatu approval
Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Pension, Superannuation - require VFSC insurance licensing consent
Trust, Trustee, Nominee - require a registered agent or trustee licence
Government, Presidential, National, State, Crown, Ministry, Authority, Commission - imply official sponsorship and require ministerial consent
Vanuatu as a name element implying governmental endorsement
University, Institute, College, Chamber of Commerce - require sector authority or Attorney-General approval
Exchange, Securities, Stock, Market, Broker, Dealer, Clearing - require financial services sector approval
Fund, Mutual, Charity - require designated regulator consent
Limited or Ltd - statutory suffix tokens, not available as root tokens
Immoral, offensive, or contrary to public policy - general statutory disqualifier
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection the applicant may file a revised name within 14 days; a formal administrative appeal is submitted in writing to the Registrar of Companies and onward to the Minister responsible for finance, accompanied by the nominal review fee and a memorandum of submissions addressing each statutory ground for refusal; if the ministerial decision remains adverse, judicial review may be pursued in the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Civil Procedure Rules; any existing reservation lapses at the end of the 30-day window unless the Registrar has granted an extension in writing.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible as the sole registered office. Every International Company must maintain a registered office at a physical street address in Vanuatu at the premises of a VFSC-licensed registered agent; a virtual or mail-forwarding address is acceptable only as an auxiliary correspondence address and does not satisfy the statutory registered office requirement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate. Approximately 30-40% annualised probability of an unannounced compliance inspection of the registered agent's premises and client files by the VFSC or the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; the probability rises to approximately 55% where UBO disclosures are incomplete, sanctions screening produces a hit, or adverse media attention arises; a low-risk AdTech entity with a clean compliance record will ordinarily experience a lower inspection frequency.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Applicable VFSC statutory fee schedule for name reservation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation and registration fee for authorized capital up to USD 50,000
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory incorporation tariff under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] fee regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficial ownership register initial filing and transmission to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory administrative fee payable through the registered agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year licensed registered agent retainer including statutory registered office, client due diligence file, and compliance officer service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in Port Vila for International Company registered agent services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of Power of Attorney, constitutional documents, UBO declarations, and corporate certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu Notary Public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs legalization desk, and foreign consular post where applicable
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff and consular statutory fee schedule at approximately USD 25-75 per seal plus courier costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English-French/Bislama translations and AML/KYC document kit assembly
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per-page certified translation tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence: UBO, PEP, OFAC, UN, EU, and domestic sanctions screening, corporate governance review, and subscriber board resolution drafting
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External Vanuatu-qualified legal counsel and due diligence provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for initial onboarding and compliance vetting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate service provider and legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for bank pre-onboarding support

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (ICA) [Cap 222], as amended, sections 6-9 (incorporation, registration and certificate), section 11 (memorandum and articles), section 14 (name restrictions), section 31 (registered office and registered agent); International Companies (Fees) Regulations [Cap 222] and Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 303].
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation issued under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], supported by the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required for an International Company. The authorized capital is set in the Articles of Association (typically a nominal VUV 5,000,000 equivalent), and shares of no par value may be issued fully for the consideration stated in the subscription schedule. No escrow, capitalized deposit, or bank pre-funding account is mandated by VFSC at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that: (1) the allotment of one hundred ordinary shares of no par value, fully paid for the consideration recorded in the subscription schedule, is hereby approved and ratified; (2) the registered office situated at the registered agent's premises in Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted as the Company's statutory registered office under Section 11 of the International Companies Act (Cap 222); (3) [Director Name] is appointed sole Director and [Secretary Name] is appointed Secretary; (4) the bank mandate initialled by the Director is approved, and the Director is authorized to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and affix the common seal; and (5) all acts of the incorporator and registered agent in forming the Company are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Corporate Name Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila (lodged through a VFSC-licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed corporate names in descending order of preference on the prescribed name-reservation application. The licensed agent confirms each name against the restricted words and existing register under Section 14 of the ICA [Cap 222]. Pay the VFSC name-reservation fee and retain the certificate of name reservation, valid for 90 days, while the incorporation file is finalized.
required_dossiers: Proposed business purpose statement (ISIC 7310 programmatic advertising technology)
Identity particulars of the proposed shareholder(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is refused as identical or deceptively similar, the agent files an amended list of alternative names within one business day. The applicant may also request written reasons and administrative re-review by the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public in the place of execution; VFSC-licensed registered agent; documents to be filed with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form prescribed by the ICA [Cap 222], adopting a single class of ordinary shares and wide commercial-object provisions covering software-as-a-service, programmatic advertising exchanges, demand-side platforms (DSP), supply-side platforms (SSP), data processing, and general electronic payments. The subscriber(s) execute the Memorandum before a notary public; the registered agent executes the consent to act. Verify the KYC due-diligence file is complete before submission.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association executed by the subscriber
Notarized proof of identity and residential address of the beneficial owner
Consent to act as registered agent
Bank, legal, or professional reference letter (KYC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC rejects the constitutional documents for non-conformity, the offending clauses are amended and resubmitted within 10 business days. Administrative corrections that do not alter substantive rights do not require re-notarization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of Incorporation Application and Statutory Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry, Port Vila (paper or registered-agent electronic lodgement)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the application for incorporation accompanied by the executed Memorandum and Articles, notice of first director(s) and secretary, notice of registered office (care of the registered agent), and written consents. Pay the official state filing fee of USD 250 plus the licensed agent's service fee. The Registrar verifies compliance with the ICA [Cap 222] sections 6-9 and the VFSC Anti-Money Laundering Rules before registration.
required_dossiers: Notice of registered office and registered agent
Consent of first director(s) and secretary
Proof of payment of the incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a requisition or query, the applicant has 30 days to file a supplemental response. If the requisition remains unsatisfied, the application lapses and may be re-submitted with a fresh application and applicable fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of all filing requirements, the Registrar enters the Company into the register of international companies, assigns a corporate number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation dated as of registration. Verify that the certificate accurately states the Company name, corporate number, legal form (International Company), and date; then place the certificate and founding documents into the statutory register at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains an error, the applicant applies under the ICA [Cap 222] for administrative correction. Typographical corrections are processed within three business days without an additional state fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Adoption of Corporate Governance Resolutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Company; VFSC-licensed registered agent acting as company secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass unanimous written resolutions to adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, approve the share allotment and issuance of share certificates, appoint the director and secretary, adopt the common seal (if desired), approve the bank mandate, and authorize the opening of a corporate bank account supporting Swift and ACH payment rails. Record minutes and resolutions in the company books maintained at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Minutes of first board meeting or unanimous written resolutions
Register of directors, officers, and members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any appointed officer declines to serve, a replacement is appointed by written resolution without convening an additional meeting. Irregular dates or venues in minutes are cured by a confirming resolution signed by all directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC; corporate bank or licensed electronic money institution accepting Vanuatu International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the first-year VFSC annual license fee and confirm the registered agent and registered office for the upcoming year. For banking, submit the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles, board resolution, and the completed KYC pack to the financial institution. Complete the beneficial ownership statements required by Vanuatu AML/CFT standards. An International Company is not required to file audited financial statements and is exempt from Vanuatu income tax, capital gains tax, and stamp duty; only the VFSC annual license renewal is mandatory.
required_dossiers: VFSC annual license fee invoice and receipt
Annual return filed under the ICA [Cap 222]
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the company is struck off for non-payment, reinstatement may be sought under the ICA [Cap 222] by settling arrears and penalties within 12 months. If a bank declines onboarding, the KYC file is supplemented and re-submitted to an alternative licensed financial institution or PSP.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a pure digital advertising-technology enterprise. Advisory registration with the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) - Foreign Investment Division - may be required only if the Company establishes a physical branch or engages in domestic trade within Vanuatu.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required - no statutory operating license or sectoral permit is mandated in Vanuatu for ISIC 7310 programmatic real-time ad-exchange and SSP activities. No VFSC financial-services license is triggered because the Company provides advertising technology only and does not conduct banking, securities, money transmission, or payment processing services (AML risk tier: Low_Risk_Standard).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards, Government of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 (excluded): the activity is an office-based digital service with no physical infrastructure, manufacturing, land disturbance, or vegetation clearing; no environmental impact statement is required under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283] and its EIA review schedules.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source discharges or VOC emissions arise from digital-only operations. Where serviced office premises are occupied, sanitary wastewater must comply with Port Vila municipal sewage bylaws and general Vanuatu waste-management standards. End-of-life IT hardware and e-waste must be transferred to authorized recyclers in accordance with the national waste management policy.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For a serviced-office footprint: fire safety certificate and inspection clearance issued by the Vanuatu Police Force Fire Service; building structural-load and occupancy approval from the Port Vila Municipality under applicable building regulations; employer liability insurance and general workplace health-and-safety duties under the Workmen's Compensation Act [Cap 123]. For a fully remote or virtual entity with no physical premises in Vanuatu, such clearances are not triggered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management (tax administration); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) (registrar and regulator of International Companies). Official portals: www.vfsc.vu; www.customs.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is statutorily tax-exempt. No income tax TIN or VAT registration ID exists or is required. The sole statutory identifier is the VFSC registration number obtained through a licensed Registered Agent (filing of memorandum and articles of association plus declaration of compliance). If a physical Port Vila presence is established, a municipal business licence is required, but this does not trigger tax registration. The IC is non-resident for tax purposes and files no Vanuatu tax return.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Not applicable. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, or VAT, so no check-the-box election, group relief election, or hybrid mismatch election exists. The exemption is automatic and non-waivable under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; no statutory mechanism permits 'opting in' to taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax regime in force; only customs import duties and stamp duties apply to physical transactions
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT/GST law exists and no indirect tax registration threshold applies. International Companies are additionally exempt from customs duties and stamp duty on their instruments, assets, transfers, and share dealings under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu has no real-time fiscal clearance system, no e-invoicing or API mandate, no digital stamping requirement, and no VAT invoice serialization. The IC may issue commercial invoices in any format without government validation, attachment of tax stamps, or fiscal transmission.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — with no VAT on the statute books, there is no zero-rating, exemption-with-credit, or refund mechanism to invoke. The IC's cross-border supply of programmatic advertising, real-time ad exchange, DSP/SSP, and retargeting services to non-Vanuatu principals is entirely outside Vanuatu's indirect tax net; receipts are invoiced gross with no VAT chargeable, withheld, or remitted.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable — intangible digital services are outside the customs territory and require no customs export declaration, bill of lading, or inward remittance certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback risk exists because no VAT is chargeable on exported digital services. Primary exposure is loss of IC tax-exempt status where the entity carries on business with Vanuatu residents or within Vanuatu without authorization; consequences include retrospective imposition of customs and stamp liabilities, municipal business-licence sanctions, VFSC monetary penalties, and strike-off or deregistration, with the statutory tax exemption certificate rendered void.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) as the central monetary and exchange-control administrator, acting alongside the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for AML/CFT supervision and International Company corporate administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu observes IMF Article VIII obligations for current-account convertibility; the VUV is the sole legal tender, but capital-account and current-account transactions by qualifying International Companies are effectively liberalized. There is no general withholding tax, capital-gains tax, or dividend tax in Vanuatu, and a VU International Company may repatriate profits by ordinary SWIFT remittance. Practical hurdles are not FX-control ceilings but rather AML/CFT documentation, source-of-funds evidence, and the domestic requirement that the paying bank verify the IC’s solvency certificate, board dividend resolution, and non-resident-source income status before releasing funds.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu does not impose compulsory export-proceeds surrender, a mandatory conversion ratio, or a statutory repatriation deadline for International Companies. Export and service receipts, including programmatic advertising and platform settlement proceeds, may be retained in the invoiced foreign currency in the IC’s external or domestic multi-currency account. Where a receiving bank files regulatory returns for RBV balance-of-payments statistics, the only practical obligation is accurate narrative classification of the remittance as service export (AdTech/SSP) rather than physical-goods export; no conversion to VUV is required.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and USD/VUV Operational Account
Multi-Currency Operational Account and Settlement Account
USD-denominated Operational Account and VUV Settlement Account
Domestic VUV Current Account and Escrow Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium feasibility. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing framework; a fully offshore digital EMI is not authorized to provide local clearing, hold client funds in VUV, or act as a settlement agent in the Vanuatu banking system. An offshore EMI may be used only as an ancillary merchant-funds conduit for non-VUV settlement if it has no physical nexus in Vanuatu, obtains its own correspondent-banking relationships, and does not present itself as a VFSC-licensed institution. Any claim of local regulatory approval must be verified through the VFSC registry; otherwise the domestic bank will treat the EMI as an unregulated third-party and apply enhanced due diligence.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: VFSC-regulated commercial banks require at least one authorized director, beneficial owner, or legal person with signing authority to appear for a live KYC interview; fully remote account opening is not generally permitted for an International Company without an existing relationship. Physical presence may take place at the bank’s primary branch in Port Vila or, where bank policy allows, before a notary or consular official using an authenticated video interview evidenced by notarized KYC documents. The local registered agent and the VU International Company head-office authorization must be produced. Banks have tightened requirements for non-resident ICs; a video interview alone is insufficient absent a signed bank mandate, verified passport, proof of address, and reference from an existing regulated banker.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The account is opened for a VU International Company with nominee directors or bearer-share characteristics.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of directors and shareholders, natural-person beneficial-ownership declaration under the International Companies Act and Vanuatu AML/CFT legislation, nominee services agreement, passport and proof of residential address for each beneficial owner, valid VFSC company certificate, and a professional intermediary reference letter from the registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Programmatic AdTech/SSP revenue patterns show high-volume, low-value payments from numerous ad networks and SSP platforms, making transaction monitoring complex.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform transaction ledger, signed programmatic advertising service agreements with major ad exchanges, monthly settlement reconciliations, breakdown of counterparty DSP/SSP relationships, transaction-monitoring policy, and KYC profiles for the top ten advertisers and publishers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border equity injection originates from a shareholder resident in a high-risk or offshore financial center.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank reference from the remitting financial institution, formal source-of-funds statement, corporate registry extracts of all upstream entities, legal ownership-chain opinion from an external attorney, audited or management financial statements of the shareholder, and sworn declaration that the investment represents genuine commercial risk capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Frequent dividend or profit distributions to foreign shareholders trigger enhanced scrutiny on fund-out movements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC tax-exemption status certificate, audited financial statements of the VU IC, board resolution declaring the distribution, legal opinion confirming no residual local creditors, evidence of no Vanuatu-source taxable business, and the paying bank’s solvency declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The lack of physical availability of all directors in Vanuatu creates an identity-verification gap.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Live identity verification through a regulated third-party identity provider, notarized passport copies and utility bills, recorded video call with the compliance officer, credit or professional-reference checks, and a mandate executed through the Vanuatu registered agent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital must be routed through a SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder’s regulated bank account to the VU IC’s domestic banking account. The remittance narrative must identify the transaction as an equity contribution to the Vanuatu International Company, reference the business purpose as a Programmatic Ad Exchange and SSP Platform, and include the corporate registration number and shareholder reference. Compliant protocol: one bank wire per share-allotment resolution, no commingling with operating revenue, and no cash or third-party-courier delivery. Purpose-code treatment should follow the IMF Balance of Payments classification for ‘Shares and other equity injection’; for ISO 20022 remittance use the free-text remittance field containing ‘INVESTMENT – SHARE CAPITAL – VU IC – PROGRAMMATIC AD DSP/SSP’. Verification: the receiving RBV-licensed bank requires the board copy of the share allotment or share issue resolution, updated register of members, source-of-funds attestation from the remitting bank, proof of beneficial owner identification, and confirmation that no part of the funding derives from proceeds of crime.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlement use SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments, inventory purchases, and operating expenses; low-value or high-frequency programmatic settlement may use ACH/Fedwire or SEPA in USD/EUR where the counterpart bank clears outside Vanuatu. Commercial letters of credit are appropriate for material infrastructure contracts and large ad-inventory procurement arrangements; the VU IC may open an LC through its domestic bank using an irrevocable, confirmed LC issued by the correspondent bank. Where settlement must occur in VUV, local clearing is executed through the RBV settlement system using a VUV-denominated account; all foreign-currency outflows require the standard anti-money-laundering release, a legitimate commercial invoice, and matching entries in the IC’s reconciliation ledger.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Custom vanilla FX forward with an RBV-licensed local dealing bank, limited to documented underlying commercial exposure with tenors typically up to 12 months.
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing VUV/USD, used when the domestic VUV money market does not provide sufficient spot liquidity for physical delivery.
Cross-currency swap (VUV/USD or VUV/AUD) for long-dated capital-expenditure assets that are matched to future foreign-currency revenues.
Vanilla European FX call or put option, where pre-approved by the dealing bank and adopted under a board-approved treasury hedging policy.
FX swap for temporary working-capital bridging, limited to covering settlement timing mismatches in the AdTech platform’s receivable and payable cycles.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation; registered agent must receive updated member, director, and charge information no later than 14 days prior
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of VUV 10,000 (approximately USD 85) plus continuing default penalties; failure to file for 90 days may trigger administrative strike-off, loss of legal capacity, and vesting of assets in the Republic of Vanuatu

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date; payment must be remitted by the licensed registered agent before the expiration of the current registration year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Additional surcharge of 10% if unpaid within 30 days after the anniversary; continued non-payment for three months exposes the company to suspension of good standing and administrative strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At the time of filing the Annual Return on each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and registered agent in Vanuatu renders the company unable to file annual documents, invalidates certificates of good standing, and constitutes grounds for strike-off by the Registrar

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company irrespective of turnover, assets, or number of shareholders. An audit may arise only through shareholder resolution, court order, or an express condition imposed by a VFSC licence; this entity does not hold a VFSC financial services licence, therefore no mandatory audit is triggered.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The International Companies Act [CAP 222] does not prescribe a public reporting framework. Internal books may be maintained under IFRS, US GAAP, or another reasonable accounting framework acceptable to the registered agent and beneficial owners.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must verify and maintain current beneficial ownership data under Vanuatu AML/CFT obligations. Any share transfer is effective only after approval by the directors and entry in the register of members; all UBO details must be reconfirmed in writing at each annual renewal before the Annual Return is filed.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Beneficial Ownership Record maintained by the registered agent

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; if voluntarily ordered, a compact private International Company typically incurs USD 3,500 – USD 7,500 for a certified audit.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax, and no withholding tax. A Vanuatu International Company (IC) registered under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) is statutorily exempt from all taxation on income, profits, distributions, and capital.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective rate is 0%. International Companies benefit from a blanket statutory exemption from inward tax and stamp duty; no income tax holiday application is required. Value Added Tax at 15% (effective 1 July 2024) applies only to domestic supplies of goods and services within Vanuatu and does not attach to the passive corporate income, royalty, interest, or dividend flows of a non-resident-owned IC engaged in programmatic AdTech operations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (prescribed form under Sections 102-103 of the International Companies Act, Cap 222), filed electronically through the VFSC Corporate Online Registry portal (e-VFSC) or by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual — a return must be lodged within 15 days following each anniversary date of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 15 days after the anniversary of incorporation. There is no fiscal-year-end CIT return because no corporate income tax is levied; the filing obligation is registry-based rather than revenue-based.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company, company/CR number, incorporation date, and country of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact IC registration number. Non-resident shareholders are not required to disclose a local operating address; the registered agent's address satisfies the registered office requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and contact details of the Vanuatu-licensed registered agent and the physical registered office address within Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC must at all times maintain a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu; use the agent's address exactly as recorded at the VFSC. No CIT/TP schedules apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C — Directors and Officer Details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, passports, country of residence, and appointment dates of each director and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident and wholly foreign; provide their jurisdiction of tax residence. No director national-residency quota is imposed on ICs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D — Share Register and Beneficial Ownership
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered shareholder details and ultimate beneficial owner declaration required for the VFSC Central Register of Beneficial Ownership (BO Registry).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the BO declaration form showing name, DOB, nationality, passport copy, and percentage of ownership/control. Beneficial owner information is treated as confidential but is exchangeable under CRS/EU administrative cooperation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the IC has not engaged in local Vanuatu-sourced commercial activity, banking, or insurance business requiring a separate license, and that the company continues to meet the IC exemption criteria.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State that the company performs no Vanuatu domestic trading and derives no Vanuatu-sourced receipts; programmatic ad exchange, SSP/DSP, and ad intermediation services executed offshore remain within the tax-exempt zone.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fixed late penalty of VT 10,000 (approximately USD 85) plus continued surcharges; if the annual return and government annual licence fee remain outstanding beyond 60 days, the Registrar may administratively strike the IC off the register. Reinstatement requires payment of all outstanding government fees plus a restoration charge of VT 25,000 (approximately USD 210).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders. Dividends, distributions, and redemption proceeds may be repatriated without prior government approval and without deduction of domestic WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement (DTA) network in force, so no conventional treaty relief protocol exists. To satisfy foreign revenue authorities, the VFSC Registrar may issue a Certificate of Tax Residence (or Exempt Status Certificate) evidencing the IC's Vanuatu incorporation and confirming its zero-tax status. The certificate, together with the registered agent's statutory declaration, is submitted in the shareholder's residence jurisdiction to support foreign-tax-credit or CFC/controlled-entity relief claims.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory and 0% treaty rate — Vanuatu does not impose non-resident withholding tax on IP royalties, licence fees, or debt interest. Outbound payments for programmatic AdTech platform licensing, SSP auction fees, DSP data usage, and intercompany loans carry no VU-source WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has not enacted transfer pricing legislation and there is no Local File, Master File, or CbCR threshold. However, the Vanuatu Economic Substance Regulations require ICs carrying on relevant activities to demonstrate adequate local substance; for non-resident AdTech principals, the relevant test is managed-and-directed from Vanuatu with adequate premises, employees, and expenditure proportionate to the platform's income.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Yes — Vanuatu enacted Economic Substance Regulations applicable to International Companies. Entities engaged in relevant activities (banking, insurance, shipping, financing and leasing, IP holding, headquarters, distribution, or service businesses) must satisfy a substance test: active Vanuatu registered office, local directors/employees with board independence, adequate physical assets and annual expenditure. A programmatic AdTech IC structured as a pure IP-holding/royalty-collecting shell without a real Vanuatu operational presence is directly exposed to ESR sanctions and automatic information exchange to OECD/EU jurisdictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of the Tax-Exempt IC Privilege
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to derive Vanuatu-sourced domestic trading income (e.g., on-island advertising contract performance or local media purchasing), misrepresenting the company's exempt status on filings, or deliberately omitting BO ownership to disguise controlled-foreign-corporation income in the shareholder's home country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Revocation of IC status; strike-off from the Vanuatu register; imposition of VAT and customs penalties up to VT 4,000,000 (approximately USD 34,000) plus interest under the Value Added Tax Act and the International Companies Act; automatic exchange of information to the beneficial owner's taxing authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute false annual returns or knowingly permit unlawful local trading face a personal fine of up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 2 years; in cross-border CFC disputes, directors of the parent group may be subject to civil restitution, travel bans in the foreign jurisdiction, and disqualification from board service.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a paper entity with no employees, no physical premises, no locally held board meetings, and no substantive AdTech management in Vanuatu, while channeling programmatic ad royalties through the entity solely to channel revenue to a zero-tax jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Regulation non-compliance declarations; fines of VT 500,000 to VT 2,000,000 per relevant activity; administrative strike-off; negative determinations shared under the network of international tax transparency and rendered to the EU/OECD. The company may also be subjected to compulsory dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face personal penalties up to VT 2,000,000 and disqualification from holding any VFSC-regulated office; in the residence state of the beneficial owner, the IC's directors and shadow directors can be jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties of the deemed CFC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the programmatic advertising IC as a conduit to enter the global payment rails (SWIFT Wire or ACH Direct) while concealing the identity of the ultimate beneficial owner; failing to file suspicious transaction reports; failing to maintain a compliance officer or transaction records; or processing ad payouts in violation of international sanctions or OFAC/EU restrictive measures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties and fines of up to VT 10,000,000 under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 23 of 2006 for anti-money-laundering failures; freezing of funds and revocation of the registered agent's licence; referral to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; contractual loss of US correspondent banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally liable for AMLA/FTRA offenses; imprisonment up to 15 years for laundering the proceeds of predicate crimes; personal confiscation orders against foreign and local assets; blanket travel bans and extradition risk for principals who knowingly allow the prosecution of sanctioned advertising counterparties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An International Company 'piggybacking' its corporate status to issue stored-value advertising credits, process third-party funds, or operate a closed-loop payment settlement system for the AdTech supply chain without holding the relevant VFSC banking or money-services license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to VT 5,000,000; immediate strike-off of the IC; criminal prosecution under the Financial Services Providers and International Companies Acts; all contracts involving the unlawful financial activity are voidable, and foreign PSPs/KYB institutions will terminate payment-rails access.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who carry on banking, deposit-taking, or money transmission without a licence commit a strict-liability criminal offense; imprisonment up to 12 years and personal liability for the return of any third-party funds; piercing of the corporate veil for the full value of the unauthorised settlement flows.
